definitions.explanation: The number 4,000, formed as {四|よん} (four) × {千|せん} (1,000). No sound change occurs, and よん is used rather than し.

examples.japanese: {四千|よんせん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧です。
examples.english: That will be four thousand yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四千|よんせん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ほどだ。
examples.english: This town has a population of about four thousand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四千|よんせん}⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}ら→上る：21460_noboru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: To reach the summit you have to climb four thousand steps.

notes:
Formed as ⟦{四|よん}→四：00767_yon⟧ × ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧. Always よんせん, never ⟦しせん→する：00392_suru⟧ — し is avoided here because it is a homophone of ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (death) and because よん is the default counting form before counters.

SOUND CHANGES IN THE THOUSANDS:
- ⟦{三千|さんぜん}→三千：00985_sanzen⟧: 3,000 — せん voices to ぜん
- ⟦{八千|はっせん}→八千：30471_hassen⟧: 8,000 — はち shortens to はっ
- ⟦{一千|いっせん}→一千：30472_issen⟧: 1,000 — いち shortens to いっ
- {四千|よんせん}, ⟦{五千|ごせん}→五千：30470_gosen⟧, ⟦{六千|ろくせん}→六千：30475_rokusen⟧, ⟦{七千|ななせん}→七千：30476_nanasen⟧, ⟦{九千|きゅうせん}→九千：30477_kyuusen⟧: regular

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {四千|よんせん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: four thousand yen
- {四千|よんせん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: four thousand people
- {四千|よんせん}⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧: in the four-thousand-metre class (of mountains)
